name: frontier-infra
description: Frontier Infra plugins for Claude: design governed AI harnesses, and score and attest them with checkable evidence.

plugins.name: frontier-infra
plugins.description: Design governed AI harnesses with checkable evidence. A developer field kit covering harness architecture, sprint contracts, deterministic drivers, governance gates, runtime health, AAR receipts, AVL ground truth, and conformance audits.

plugins.name: frontier-audit
plugins.description: Score and attest AI harnesses. A thin adoption layer over the installable Frontier Audit SDK: inspects local SDK availability, requires explicit install authorization, verifies version and provenance, then runs the SDK-owned audit and attestation workflow.
